SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init();

KBSECTION
// 14 - Temperance (the Resonant). Goal: cause reactions; 3 / 6 / 15 in ARCANA_Aspect_Common.txt (spec 9).
//   Tier I Resonance and the feelings +2 of Tier II live in Stats. Here: the count, the free Surge of Tier II Harmony
//   and the Tier III wave. GENERATED by gen_emotion_alchemy.pl -- do not edit by hand.
//REGION Tables
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_PeakMood(_P, _M)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_PeakMood(_P, _M);

PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus("FEELING_AGGRESSIVENESS");

DB_ARCANA_Resonant_PeakMood("EMOTION_ANTICIPATION", "MOOD_INTERESTED");

IF
SavegameLoaded()
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init();
//END_REGION

//REGION Goal: every feeling, intense emotion and Catharsis caused (The Two Cups: each one)
IF
StatusApplied(_Target, _Status, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_Status)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_Aspect_Temperance_Awakening", 1)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Step(_Resonant, "TEMPERANCE");
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier II: Harmony -- once per turn a Weave Surge costs no action (R40; the Fool's Zephyr Strike pattern)
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_OnTier((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Aspect, (INTEGER)_Tier)
AND
_Aspect == "TEMPERANCE"
AND
_Tier == 2
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_TIER2", -1.0, 1, _Resonant);

IF
TurnStarted((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_AspectReached(_Resonant, 2)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);

IF
CastedSpell((CHARACTER)_Resonant, _Spell, _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Root)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_Root, _)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 1)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", _Resonant);

// R42: the free Surge leaves its mood at once, so the second Surge of the turn can react. Marked when it is cast
// (UsingSpellOnTarget comes before the effect), spent when its peak lands; an unused mark ends with the turn.
IF
UsingSpellOnTarget((CHARACTER)_Resonant, _, _Spell, _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Root)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_Root, _)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Resonant, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", 1)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Resonant);

IF
StatusApplied(_Target, _Peak, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_PeakMood(_Peak, _Mood)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Resonant)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Target, _Mood, 42.0, 1, _Resonant);

IF
TurnStarted((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Resonant)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Reset((CHARACTER)_Char)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Char)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Echo(_Char);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Reset((CHARACTER)_Char)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Char, "RESONANT_SURGE_FREE", _Char);
RemoveStatus(_Char, "RESONANT_TIER2", _Char);
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier III: Emotional Overload reaches every enemy within 6 m of the target that carries a feeling (first collect, then apply)
IF
UsingSpellOnTarget((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Target, _Spell, _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, "Target_Arcana_Created_EmotionalOverload")
AND
DB_ARCANA_AspectReached(_Resonant, 3)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Resonant, _Combat)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveCollect(_Resonant, _Target, _Combat);
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply(_Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveCollect((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Target, (GUIDSTRING)_Combat)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Cand, _Combat)
AND
_Cand != _Target
AND
IsEnemy(_Resonant, _Cand, 1)
AND
IsDead(_Cand, 0)
AND
GetDistanceTo(_Target, _Cand, _Dist)
AND
_Dist <= 6.0
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_Feeling)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, 1)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_Feeling)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, 1)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, _Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand);
ApplyStatus(_Cand, "PARALYZED", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);
//END_REGION
EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
